summary_en: ¥56.00/share (prior ¥50.00), increase of ¥6.00 (+12.0%). Announced alongside upward revision of FY12/26 consolidated earnings (revenue ¥11,000M, operating profit ¥3,100M) following completion of Zero One Brain 100% acquisition on 31 July 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding revision (upward revision) of full-year consolidated earnings forecast for FY12/26 and revision (dividend increase) of dividend forecast
translation_en_brief:
One Career Inc. announced an increase to its dividend forecast for FY12/26 (year ended 31 December 2026) from ¥50.00 per share to ¥56.00 per share, representing a ¥6.00 (+12.0%) increase. The dividend hike is disclosed alongside an upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance, reflecting the completion on 31 July 2026 of the acquisition of 100% of Zero One Brain Co., Ltd. (and its operating subsidiary Kids Corporation). The acquisition was initially announced on 26 March 2026.

With the acquisition now completed, consolidated revenues are revised upward to ¥11,000 million (prior forecast ¥10,500M, +4.8%), operating profit to ¥3,100 million (prior ¥3,000M, +3.3%), and net income attributable to parent shareholders to ¥2,151 million (prior ¥2,123M, +1.3%). The consolidated P&L will reflect only the fourth quarter (October–December 2026) results of the acquired companies, as the deemed acquisition date is set as 30 September 2026 (Q3 close). The filing notes that goodwill and allocation of purchase price (PPA) procedures are not yet finalized and may adjust the forecast.
